name: the invitation
headline: The hive is *yours*.
say: Hypercomb is a bet that the internet can be shaped like a community instead of like a corporation. Small tiles. Simple rules. Signatures instead of a central authority. History instead of forgetting. People instead of platforms. It grows the way a colony grows: everyone who joins adds what they need, and can share it back. You have seen the real thing running. Type a name, press Enter, and you have begun. The hive is yours.
